correctness.rationale: Exact conditional ideal interval recurrence established by yes/no closure. Every branch shrinks the free set, giving terminating induction. Maximal antichain count bounds states by O(n^{2w}); the algorithm tests n free query locations per state. For 2-by-(2^{k+1}-2), a product subfamily supplies depth 2k and the hypothesis-count upper bound is 2k. The independent executable verifies 242 posets, direct grid ranks to n=6, and all ranks through n=30; finite cases are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Structural exact algorithm uniformly across all bounded-width finite posets replaces arbitrary hypothesis-subset recursion with two ideal boundaries. A genuine infinite family of two-row grids attains the entropy upper bound exactly at dyadic sizes, despite VC dimension fixed at two; this gives sharp benchmark instances for adaptive learning and a rigorous separation from static shattering. The all-n exact rank is algorithmically accessible, without making an unjustified closed-form claim.
